description: Add share entries (users and groups) to a data model.

datamodel_name.description: Name of the data model to add shares to.

shares.description: List of share definitions to add. Each dictionary should include: ``name`` (user email or group name), ``type`` (``"user"`` or ``"group"``), and ``permission`` (one of ``"EDIT"``, ``"READ"``, ``"USE"``).

examples.user_query: Give the 'Sales Team' group edit access and john.doe@example.com read access to the 'Revenue Analysis' data model.
examples.notes: This call adds edit access for the Sales team and read access for John Doe to the 'Revenue Analysis' data model.

examples.user_query: I need to grant usage permissions to the Marketing group for the 'Customer Insights' data model.
examples.notes: This call grants usage permissions to the Marketing group for the 'Customer Insights' data model.

examples.user_query: Can I add both read access for Jane Smith and edit access for the Admin group to the 'Product Performance' data model?
examples.notes: This call adds read access for Jane Smith and edit access for the Admin group to the 'Product Performance' data model.
